newsitem.title: LATVIA: C.BANK FOREIGN ASSETS ROSE 8 PCT IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK FOREIGN ASSETS ROSE 8 PCT IN MAY.

text.p: The central bank on Wednesday said that its net foreign gold and currency assets rose eight percent in May to 394.9 million lats from April's level.
The rise in foreign assets was mainly due to the purchase of foreign currencies for lats, Einars Repshe, central bank governor, told a news conference.
The bank said the rise was also due to the German investors' payment for their 16 percent stake in the Latvian Gas in May, worth some 10 million lats.
The amount of lats in ciculation rose by 30 million lats or 2.9 percent to 351.7 million lats from April.
